notes: TBox expansion, paired with people-replace-0019. Keeps the revision's relation (has_minimum_age) and new conclusion (at least 40 years old) and gives it to a made-up body, the Ostrelund Parish Council, under the real class of elected local councils, so no old value is pushed out. The derived queries name invented councillors with the membership stated in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops, bridge in the prompt): the inserted rule is their only route to the age. The near unrelated query asks the real minimum age for a United States Senator, which must stay 30; a method that learned a bare 'office-holder must be 40' mapping would leak there. Council and councillor names are invented; the counting step records that they are absent from the corpus. Side facts and checks are those of the paired revision.
